complete_criteria.primary: Actual C original USERdraft jointly includes both complete guide roles: documented identity explanation AND whole separately imported-definition pattern with its code-edit/reload caveat. Record generic omission separately.
complete_criteria.strict_success_threshold: Treatment joint complete guidance in at least3of4Cturns including at least1of2actually released corrections, and strictly more joint-coverage drafts than fresh control; all semantic safety/current-version/quote/operational checks must pass. Failure stays reported and no default promotion.
complete_criteria.unit: Four Cturns are two repetitions of ONE exposed case; released corrections2perarm; initial drafts are not delivered. No population accuracy inference.
complete_criteria.secondary: Whole generic quote selected, original/released draft chars, paired coverage-preserving reductions, timing/actual sends/local costs and A/B nonregression. Shorter length is not human usefulness.
complete_criteria.A_B_nonregression: Retain necessary answerable questions and actual partial button contract; do not add unrelated guide content or unsupported claim.
complete_criteria.all_claims_surfaces: Review all important claims and qualifiers in originaldraft/summary/rationale/claims/sources vs actual full text/currentfacts; actualreleased text separately, edited text if present separately.
complete_criteria.widget_scope: Enum coercion is widget-returned values; direct SessionState code contains no widget. No runtime cause/fix claim or manufactured exact-version metadata.
complete_criteria.reviewer: unblinded assistant; implementation/test overlap must be disclosed
